item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00040","case1_error":"Uses the false conversion rate 1.16 ounces per pound instead of 16.","case2_error":"Omits the $7 round-trip subway fare when calculating money available for apples.","reason":"One uses an incorrect unit conversion; the other omits a required expense.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00041","case1_error":"Treats existing fuel as total capacity, then subtracts only the truck's existing fuel to calculate the refill.","case2_error":"Replaces Friday's 40% increase with a 15% increase applied across five days.","reason":"The first confuses existing fuel with capacity and refill needs; the second changes both the percentage and its scope.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00042","case1_error":"Answers with total beverage volume, 72 ounces, instead of using the ratio to calculate 9 ounces of tea ingredient.","case2_error":"Omits the 30 oranges reserved for juice when calculating oranges available for sale.","reason":"The first answers the wrong quantity; the second omits a required subtraction.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00043","case1_error":"Treats the 12 additional green apples as the entire green-apple count.","case2_error":"Divides by servings per batch twice, mislabeling the initial 15 batches as servings and reducing the batch count again.","reason":"The first substitutes a difference for a total count; the second repeats a conversion already performed.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00044","case1_error":"Uses purchase cost per egg instead of the stated selling price to calculate how many sales recover capital.","case2_error":"Provides an unsupported final total of 1020 after correct formulas that yield 840; intervening numbers lack explained calculations.","reason":"The first explicitly selects the wrong rate; the second supplies incorrect numbers without showing how they follow from correct formulas.","judgment":"different"}]}
